2026-11-23ESDC, CEICEmployment Insurance ActRegulations Amending the Employment Insurance RegulationsRegulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations in order to (1) add references to the EI adoption benefit to provisions that apply to other EI special benefits; and (2) adapt provisions related to the coordination of EI benefits with corresponding provincial benefits.N/A
subject: Regulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Employment Insurance Regulations in order to (1) add references to the EI adoption benefit to provisions that apply to other EI special benefits; and (2) adapt provisions related to the coordination of EI benefits with corresponding provincial benefits.
